milestones.title: Foundation and failing tests
milestones.description: Set up the project skeleton and write the first failing tests.

todos.text: Write failing unit tests for the core behaviour
Set up the project structure and dependencies
Write failing node:test specs: paste parser, task store, persistence
Create shared core folder layout, task model skeleton, package.json test script
Confirm no runtime dependency and no build step

milestones.note: Shared core skeleton, package.json test script, gitignore; 63 node:test specs green (npm run check)

milestones.title: Implement the core
milestones.description: Make the tests pass with the simplest correct implementation.

todos.text: Write/adjust unit tests for the behaviour
Implement paste parser with per-line quadrant preview
Implement task store: add, edit, delete, move, reorder, complete
Implement versioned persistence + one-time legacy migration with fail-safe
Implement JSON and CSV import/export with round-trip test

milestones.note: Parser, store, versioned persistence with legacy migration, and JSON/CSV interchange implemented; 68 node:test specs green

milestones.title: Validate, document and ship
milestones.description: Run the full suite, document usage, and push a clean tree.

todos.text: Run the full test suite, formatter and linter
Build responsive 2x2 grid UI, drag-and-drop, keyboard path, no innerHTML
Build standalone web app and bring the extension to parity
Deploy to VPS behind nginx and finish README/STATUS/CHECKS
Apply the deployment on the VPS (human action: the commands are in deploy/README.md and CHECKS.md)

milestones.note: UI, web app, extension parity, docs and the deployment files are done: 127 node:test specs green, the browser smoke test green, README/STATUS/CHECKS written; the site is applied by the owner with the commands in deploy/README.md
